name: Saint Martin of Tours
history: A Roman soldier who, at the gates of Amiens, cut his cloak in half for a freezing beggar and that night saw Christ wearing it. He became a monk and bishop of Tours, one of the first saints venerated who was not a martyr. His feast fell on the day the 1918 Armistice was signed.
fast: Martinmas once began 'Saint Martin's Lent', a forty-day fast before Christmas. Consider an Advent discipline beginning today.
meditation: Whom will you give half your cloak to this week?
prayer: O God, Who see that we cannot survive by any power of our own, mercifully grant that, by the intercession of blessed Martin, Your Confessor and Bishop, we may be made safe from all harm. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
